title: Outdoor Girl Tomato - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Outdoor Tomato Variety
description:
Discover the joy of growing your own 'Outdoor Girl' tomatoes, a fantastic early-maturing variety specifically bred for outdoor cultivation in the UK climate. These robust plants reliably produce a good harvest of medium-sized, billiard ball-sized fruits with a full, sweet/acidic flavour.

'Outdoor Girl' is a cordon (indeterminate) type tomato, meaning it will continue to grow and produce fruit throughout the season until frost. It's an excellent choice for beginner gardeners due to its ease of care and resilience. The RHS has recognised its outstanding qualities with an Award of Garden Merit (AGM) since 1993.

These plug plants are a great way to get a head start on your tomato season, allowing you to enjoy fresh, homegrown tomatoes earlier. They are versatile, suitable for containers or beds, and offer good resistance to common tomato diseases, ensuring healthier plants and higher yields.

Enjoy 'Outdoor Girl' tomatoes fresh in salads, roasted, or used in preserves. Their vibrant red colour and good texture make them a delightful addition to any meal.
